dict.title: Lists
dict.subtitle: Your lists for client files and cases: visa purposes, channels, partners, registrars, prepayments, systems and passwords for the vault, currencies.
dict.purposesHint: Each purpose has its own queue at the visa center. Switch off a purpose you no longer use — old cases keep it.

dict.name: Name
dict.partnersHint: People who bring clients for a fee. Their terms are filled into a case by country and can be changed there.

dict.moneyAdminHint: The accounting currency and the tax rate are set by the platform administrator.
dict.vaultSystemsHint: Sites accounts are made on, and each site's password requirements: the vault's generator follows them.

dict.passwordSymbolsHint: The ones the site accepts; empty — none.

import.title: Spreadsheet import
import.subtitle: Move your Google Sheets into the CRM: columns are mapped once and remembered
import.order: Import in order: «Consultations» first, then «Clients in progress», then queues, applications and bookings — so one person becomes one card and the records find their case. A repeated import updates rows imported before, without duplicates.
import.kindHint.consultations: Contacts and consultations: date, decision, countries, fee, notes
import.kindHint.cases: Cases: country, purpose, registrar, dates, result, money; mailboxes and passwords to the vault
import.kindHint.queue: Poland, Latvia, Italy: queued, VAC ID, letter, removal. One country per spreadsheet
import.kindHint.attempts: France: application date, 60th day, applications sent again and “not again”
import.kindHint.bookings: Hotels: dates, booking number, free cancellation — to the client's case
import.fileHint: In Google Sheets: File → Download → Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) — all sheets in one file — or CSV/TSV for one sheet. Up to 5 MB and 5000 rows.
import.headerRowHint: If the spreadsheet has a title above it, the headers are below
import.found: Rows with data: {{rows}}, headers in row {{header}}.

import.missing: Choose columns for the required fields: {{fields}}
import.currencyHint: For sums without a currency. Cases keep sums in the base currency
import.system.site: Site logins — to the vault system
import.checkNote: This is a check: nothing is written to the CRM yet. See what will be imported and which rows are skipped.

import.passwordsMoved_other: {{count}} passwords moved to the vault. Check that everything is in place and delete the passwords from Google Sheets.
import.nothingChanges: Nothing new: everything is already in the CRM.
import.warningRows: Warnings: the row is imported, the value is not
import.moreIssues: And {{count}} more — the report keeps the first 1000
import.reason.no_date: no date, or it could not be read
import.reason.no_country: no country, or it was not found
import.reason.no_case: the client or their case was not found — import «Clients in progress» first
import.reason.no_window: the country has no application window — add a column with the 60th day
import.reason.row_error: the database refused the row — check its values
import.reason.bad: the value could not be read: too long or an unknown format
import.reason.bad_date: the date could not be read — use 12.06.2026
import.reason.bad_phone: the phone could not be read — it needs the country code
import.reason.bad_telegram: the Telegram nick could not be read
import.reason.bad_contacts: neither a phone nor a Telegram nick
import.reason.bad_money: the sum could not be read — one sum per cell
import.reason.bad_decision: unknown decision: yes, no or thinking
import.reason.bad_outcome: unknown result — set it in the case by hand
import.reason.foreign_currency: a sum in another currency — cases keep sums in the base currency, enter it by hand
import.reason.unknown_value: not found in the list — the field is left empty
import.reason.phone_taken: this phone already belongs to another card
import.reason.date_order: the dates are out of order — left as they were
import.reason.out_of_range: the number is out of range
import.reason.no_login: a password without a login — not moved
import.reason.too_long: the value is too long — not moved
import.reason.truncated: the text is too long — its beginning is moved
import.reason.date_without_year: a date without a year — the year from the sheet name (or this year) is used, check it
import.reason.date_month_only: only the month is given — the 1st is used
import.reason.date_from_month: no day — the 1st of the month of the request is used
import.reason.year_only: only the year is given — the date is left empty
import.reason.several_people: several people in one cell — one card is created, split it by hand
import.reason.unlikely_birth_date: a birth date in the future or before 1910 — not moved
import.reason.talon_without_registrar: a talon without a registrar (“-”, “me”) — not moved
import.reason.not_a_queue: this country has no waiting list — the queue date is not moved
import.reason.email_not_number: an email instead of the number — the number is left empty
import.reason.removal_without_date: “removed from the queue” without a date — remove the entry by hand
import.reason.password_not_saved: the password next to the email is not saved: choose a vault system for mailboxes

import.cityUnknown: Not among this country's submission cities — the field stays empty

templates.howTo.title: How to make a template
templates.howTo.write: Open your document in Word or Google Docs: a sponsor letter, a statement, a cover letter, a power of attorney, a contract.
templates.howTo.codes: Where the client's data goes, write a code in double curly braces instead of the data, e.g. «I, {{Full name}}, born {{Date of birth}}». The codes are in the table below; a tap copies one.
templates.howTo.upload: Press «Upload a template» on this page. The CRM shows the codes it found and, separately, the unknown ones (usually typos).
templates.howTo.give: In the client's card, in «Documents from templates», press «Add» and choose the template and the case the document is for.
templates.howTo.download: Press the document in the card — the file downloads with the client's data, named for the client. The data is taken at the moment of download: fixed the card — download again.
templates.rules.title: Rules
templates.rules.anyCase: Case, spaces and underscores do not matter: {{Full name}}, {{full name}} and {{ full_name }} are one code.
templates.rules.language: A code can be written in Russian or in English. The code's language is the value's language: {{Гражданство}} gives «Беларусь», {{Nationality}} gives «Belarus». Sums follow the language too.
templates.rules.grammar: Countries, purposes and other values go in as they are, in their basic form: in Russian text write «Страна поездки: {{Страна визы}}» rather than «поездка в {{Страна визы}}», which needs another case ending.
templates.rules.format: The value takes the code's formatting: font, size, bold. Format the whole code — the value will look the same.
templates.rules.where: Codes work in text, tables, headers and footers, footnotes and text boxes. One code stays within one paragraph, without a line break.
templates.rules.empty: If something is not filled in for the client, the code's place stays empty. The card shows in advance what is missing.
templates.rules.unknown: An unknown code stays in the document as written, so a typo is seen at once. Dates are written as 05.10.1990.
